content.value: During the busy hour, 1200 calls were offered to a group of trunks and six calls were lost. The average duration was 3 minutes ,
Find: (i) the traffic offered (ii) the traffic carried (iii) the traffic lost (iv) the grade of service (v) the total duration of the periods of congestion.
